scope: Complete Slack gateway features: outbound artifacts delivery, Block Kit rich replies, feedback buttons, task cancellation, workflow-thread semantics, and Socket Mode.
implemented: Rich Block Kit replies with section chunking within 3000 chars, elapsed runtime indicators, and status context.
Outbound artifact delivery via files_upload_v2/files_upload with size validation (16 MiB per artifact, 32 MiB total).
Workflow thread semantics with workflow_threads/threaded_workflows opt-in, distinct from agent threads.
Interactive feedback controls with thumbs-up and thumbs-down buttons recorded in collaboration feedback.
Interactive cancellation button and in-thread cancel commands terminating active and waiting workflow/agent runs.
Socket Mode client over slack_sdk.socket_mode.builtin.SocketModeClient handling envelope acknowledgments and dispatching events.
